testcase.name: moving an image up crosses the preceding text block and preserves identity
moving at a boundary is a no op
moving across the following text block preserves every text character
moving down keeps unanchored images accessible
moving an unanchored image up materializes its marker without losing any image
moving a marker with only a preceding separator keeps one readable gap
reordering uses the current edited text rather than a stale persisted copy
share export follows the moved marker order
